title: The Pin Arrives Late
setup: Black's knight on e5 is defended by the f6-pawn, and your own knight on f3 is blocking your queen.
hint: The pawn guarding e5 is free to capture right now. What changes on the f-file the moment your knight leaves?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Nxe5}} wins a piece. The f6-pawn defends e5 — until your knight steps off f3 and your queen on **f2** sees the whole file to the king on **f8**. The pawn is pinned the instant it is needed, so it cannot recapture.
